owner_request: Owner supplies proposed reference anticoagulation/vascular pathway; standing instruction to mark completed reviewed modules GREEN

primary_sources.access: Full guideline PDF previously retrieved and current recommendations checked
Full hospital source page; institutional VTE regimen not adopted as mesenteric nomogram

proposed_changes.baseline: Document CBC/platelets, aPTT/INR, renal function/electrolytes and bleeding/HIT context
proposed_changes.anticoagulation: Therapeutic anticoagulation for arterial AMI unless contraindicated, coordinated before intervention; peritonitis alone is not an instruction to omit or defer UFH
proposed_changes.monitoring: aPTT commonly4-6h after start/rate change per verified nomogram, laboratory-specific target; anti-Xa if aPTT unsuitable. Do not impose universal two-stable-check rule.
proposed_changes.NOMI: Restore flow/treat cause; systemic heparin may be considered case-by-case absent bleeding. Intra-arterial vasodilator under protective heparinization is separate specialist intervention, not an automatic prophylactic/therapeutic-dose order
proposed_changes.surgery: Peritonitis or deterioration requires urgent surgery assessment, not waiting for proven transmural infarction. Endovascular/open/hybrid selected by anatomy, bowel viability and available expertise
proposed_changes.support: Titrated fluid resuscitation, not indiscriminate aggressive volume; do not delay team activation until CTA
not_adopted: No default bolus omission just for peritonitis
No automatic open-versus-endovascular split based solely on instability

strength_certainty: ESVS50 I C for MVT anticoagulation; ESVS37 IIa B endovascular arterial option; ESVS45 IIb C NOMI vasodilators. Institutional UFH monitoring guidance is not universal society evidence.
